data.summary: Meridian Bank and Nimbus Labs kicked off the Nimbus Ledger Sync pilot to automate UPI reconciliation by November 30. The meeting established project scope, security compliance steps, and initial deliverables.
decisions: Pilot go-live date is set for Monday 30 November 2026
Phase one is limited to UPI reconciliation only
Primary hosting is AWS Mumbai with a disaster recovery replica in Singapore
